full_details: The new wheat opened at six-and-thirty shillings the quarter. You did not buy it. Joan sold the gloves. Richard stood behind them. The children took you north, past the Rother Market. The row was some twenty plots, wattle charred, a chimney standing, weeds in the ash. Your father was on the fourth rung. At the end plot you gave twenty shillings toward the timber, and your name for a dozen men if the frame is pegged by Tuesday. At the bakehouse Quiney asked two pounds for his own malt-house, not for the town. You said yes before Anne looked at you. Judith Sadler made the word be loan. A pound by Martinmas or soon after, the rest by Lady Day, and no use. She promised the three children a pie on Sunday. In the street Anne said that is two pounds you know where it is. At home you wrote the timber and the loan as two lines, and you did not write a total.
one_sentence: At the Cross the wheat was six-and-thirty, and you gave twenty shillings to a barn and two pounds to Quiney.
title: Twenty shillings, and two pounds beside them
